title: prunus dolichophylla
intro: Prunus dolichophylla, commonly known as Chinese cherry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Prunus dolichophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's extracts have also been found to exhibit neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of ongoing research in traditional medicine.
